question: Should ClawScan accept the canonical autoreview model-default and smoke-harness engine changes unchanged?
rationale: The implementation is exact and validated, but the synchronization intentionally changes existing repository-local helper invocations, which should be accepted explicitly rather than silently treated as compatibility-neutral.

options.title: Adopt canonical behavior
options.body: Merge the byte-identical canonical tree and update any affected local invocations to the supported defaults and smoke-harness engines.

options.title: Adjust canonical upstream first
options.body: If ClawScan must retain the old invocation behavior, change and validate openclaw/agent-skills first and then resync the complete directory.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the byte-identical canonical tree and update any affected local invocations to the supported defaults and smoke-harness engines.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the requested reviewer and the most recent merger connected to the current-main autoreview path.
